author: Kate Slotover
content: Agree with the other comments that the website info seems a little fierce, but I guess this avoids lots of problems and our experience was that Dancing Cubs were incredibly helpful, great at communicating, the equipment was delivered and collected exactly on time – and all our little ones loved it. We will definitely be using them again. If you're having a party for 3-4 year olds can recommend the large lego bricks, they were a great success (we got two sets), and we also had the little bouncy castle. Perfect.
